    d = json.decode('{"z":1,"a":2,"z":3,"nested":[{"k":null}]}')
    results["order.json"] = json.encode([d.keys(),d])
    d["nested"][0]["k"] = ["mutable"]
    d["nested"].append(4)
    results["mutable.json"] = json.encode(d)
    d["nested"].append(5)
    json.encode_indent(d)
    d["nested"].append(6)
    results["no_freeze.json"] = json.encode(d)
    results["struct.json"] = json.encode(struct(z=(1,2),a=struct(k=[])))
    results["strings.json"] = json.encode(["", "\000\001\b\f\n\r\t\"\\/", "é😀\177", json.decode('"\\u00e9\\ud83d\\ude00"'), json.decode('"\\ud800X\\udc00"')])

    got.append("same-default")
    results["fallback.json"] = json.encode([fallback,json.decode("!",None),json.decode("null",default=42),json.decode("bad",default={"ok":1})])
    malformed=["", "[1,]", '{"x":1,}', "01", "+1", ".1", "1.", "1e", "NaN", "Infinity", '"\\q"', '"\\uZZZZ"', '"raw\ncontrol"', "null true", "/*x*/null", "{1:2}", "5.E1", "5.e1"]
    results["malformed_fallback.json"] = json.encode([[s,json.decode(s,default="INVALID")] for s in malformed])
    results["overflow.json"] = json.encode([str(json.decode("1e999")),str(json.decode("-1e999")),type(json.decode("1e999"))])
    results["indent_default.json"] = json.encode_indent({"z":[],"a":[1,{"k":True}]})
    results["indent_custom.json"] = json.encode_indent({"b":{},"a":[1,2]},prefix=">",indent="..")
    results["indent_preserve.json"] = json.indent(' {"z":1e+02,"z":2,"a":"\\u0061"} \n',indent=" ")

    files=[]
    for name,content in results.items():
        f=ctx.actions.declare_file(name)

        files.append(f)
    return [DefaultInfo(files=depset(files))]
